title: Integral Multipliers and Arithmetic Obstructions for Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Maxima
abstract: arXiv:2611.27018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study exact representations of maximum functions by ReLU networks with two hidden layers and integer parameters. The least positive output multiplier is two for the six-input maximum, and either two or six for the seven-input maximum. We obtain these bounds from integral cubical fillings and a coefficient-preserving passage from polytope identities to networks. For the coordinate-facet complex of the six-simplex, we compute a coning index of six over the integers and three after inverting two, allowing arbitrary integral directions within each facet. A class in the homology of the unrestricted kernel complex characterizes the remaining seven-input problem; its vanishing is equivalent to an integral filling of a fixed target. We also construct a finite character that separates rational from three-local representability in a dictionary containing two known constructions and all pairs of edge-disjoint three-edge forests. translated_title: 双隐藏层ReLU最大值函数的整数乘子与算术障碍
translated_abstract: 我们研究用具有两个隐藏层且参数为整数的ReLU网络对最大值函数的精确表示。对于六输入最大值函数，最小正输出乘子为2；对于七输入最大值函数，最小正输出乘子为2或6。我们通过整数立方填充以及从多面体恒等式到网络的保系数转换获得这些界。对于六单纯形的坐标面复形，我们计算出其整数上的锥化指数为6，而在将2取逆后为3，从而允许每个面内任意的整数方向。无限制核复形同调中的一个类刻画了剩余的七输入问题；该类的消失等价于对固定目标实现整数填充。我们还构造了一个有限判别准则，在一个包含两个已知构造以及所有边不交三边森林对的字典中，将有理可表示性与三局可表示性区分开来。此障碍（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文借助代数拓扑工具（整数立方填充与同调障碍类）证明了双隐藏层整数参数ReLU网络精确表示最大值函数的最小正输出乘子——六输入为2、七输入为2或6，并刻画了七输入情形中剩余的算术障碍。
en_tdlr: Using algebraic-topological tools such as integral cubical fillings and homology obstruction classes, this paper proves that the least positive output multiplier for exactly representing max functions by two-hidden-layer ReLU networks with integer parameters is 2 for six inputs and either 2 or 6 for seven inputs.
